🕵️ Shadow Trader Digest – 23 August 2026


Three under-the-radar events that might quietly move markets this week:



  1. 🇦🇺 CHESS replacement — industry rehearsal 4
    Wednesday, 26 August · ASX
    Sub-register migration dry run; broker confirmations get rerouted to the new stack.
    Source →

  2. 🇺🇸 T+1 settlement testing — extended hours
    Thursday, 27 August · DTCC
    Post-close allocation and confirm test across custodians ahead of the next cutover rehearsal.
    Source →

  3. 🇩🇪 Ifo business climate
    Monday, 24 August · Ifo Institute
    German sentiment thermometer; the expectations-vs-current gap is what repositioning trades on.
    Source →


Stay hidden. Stay ahead.
— Goldirham Whisper
